algorithm.title: Suggested Algorithm for Selecting Migraine Prophylaxis.

cell.label: Patient candidate for pharmacologic migraine prophylaxis (e.g., 2 migraine/mo, 3 mo disability 3 disability d/mo)
Consider a first-line agent, if no contraindication: Propranolol or timolol; amitriptyline; divalproex sodium or sodium valproate; topiramate.
Schedule regular follow-up visits to monitor medication use.
Adjust dose as tolerated. If adverse effects or ineffective try different first-line agent (propranolol or timolol, amitriptyline, divalproex, or topiramate). Effective after 2-3 mo?
If no single first-line drug is effective and tolerable, consider a combination of two first-line agents. Effective after 2-3 mo?

Consider an alternative agent, if no contraindications: Gabapentin; naproxen sodium; candesartan; lisinopril; atenolol, metoprolol, or nadolol; magnesium; riboflavin (B2) or coenzyme Q10; hormone therapy; timed-released DHE; verapamil; feverfew.
